page_title: DBine: Database Manager for 130+ Engines | Free Desktop App

sources.entry: DBine - Open-source database manager for 130+ SQL and NoSQL databases and cloud services, with notebooks, schema and data compare, and an MCP server. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/addlayer-io/dbine) ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]

summary.name: DBine
summary.one_liner: DBine is a free desktop database manager that connects to 130+ SQL, NoSQL, analytical and cloud database engines from one app.
use_cases: Query and edit databases from one app
Compare schemas between development and production
Migrate tables between different database engines
Profile live queries hitting a database
Let AI assistants like Claude Code work with database connections under set limits
Sync rows between two tables on different servers
summary.what_it_does: DBine connects to 130+ database engines and services, including SQL Server, PostgreSQL, Oracle, MongoDB, Snowflake and Redis, each through its own built-in driver. It includes a live query profiler, a real-time server monitor, and schema and row-level compare with generated sync scripts. It can convert tables and types from one engine to another with a report. It also offers an AI chat panel that writes or explains queries without running them, and a local MCP server that lets external AI clients work with connections, with per-connection access levels and approval for writes.
notable: Supports 130+ engines with a driver per engine, no vendor client tools needed
Live query profiler works beyond SQL Server, with read-only connections changing nothing on the server
Local MCP server with per-connection access levels and approval for every write
Connections and passwords stay on device; sync is end-to-end encrypted
caveats: Sync and some features depend on the user's own Google Drive, OneDrive or folder
winget may install an earlier version that then self-updates
MCP server only works while DBine is open and only listens on the local machine
